Sealed a [full author proof of T253M73](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-arithmetic-discovery-r73/candidate.md), preserving every source-admissible \(a\) and every finite \(m\ge1\):

\[
H_2(A_{a,m};\mathbb Z)\cong
\mathbb Z\oplus(\mathbb Z/2)^{M_a+9+2\mathbf1_{3\mid a}},
\qquad M_a=|\operatorname{Norm}(1-\tau^{2a})|.
\]

The proof completes the integral corner calculation and constructs a stable lift resolving the torsion ambiguity. No author-side mathematical gap is asserted. **Independent correctness and contribution gates remain open**, especially the spectrum comparison in Section4. No substantiality rating or count credit is claimed.
